text.content: You have now seen the four core resilience patterns — timeouts, retries, fallbacks, and circuit breakers — and how each addresses a different class of failure. In this lesson you apply what you learned to your own project agent. A project orchestration should not assume that every agent, tool, or MCP call will succeed on the first attempt; this lesson is where you decide what your workflow does when they don't.
